'
Til You Cry
" is a song written by Steve Bogard and Rick Giles, and recorded by American
country pop
artist
Juice Newton
for her 1987 album
Emotion
. In 1988, it was covered by American country music artist
Eddy Raven
and released in December as the third single from his compilation album
The Best of Eddy Raven
. The song reached number 4 on the
Billboard
Hot Country Singles & Tracks
chart.
